Show details of one or many resources

Usage: slipway describe [OPTIONS] (<TYPE> [NAME]... | <TYPE/NAME>...)

Arguments:
  <TYPE>     The resource type, by its plural, singular or short name (see api-resources)
  [NAME]...  The name of a resource of that type

Options:
  -l, --selector <EXPR>        Selector (label query) to filter on
      --field-selector <EXPR>  Selector (field query) to filter on
  -A, --all-groups             List the requested objects across all groups
  -h, --help                   Print help (see more with '--help')

Use "slipway --help" for a list of global options (applies to all commands).
